author: Tarheelkiwi
body:
I was looking through the forums to see if someone already mentioned this but I couldn't find it.  Anyways... a private message function on the website would be nice considering not everyone has access to Skype and this would be faster then having to look to see if the player has his/her Skype on their profile, then wait until they accept you.  And if that player isn't an active forum member, maybe they will see the notification in game or something like that IDK.  

If there is already a thread about this please let me know but at least this idea was put out there :D
